# GiftStub

> GiftStub is a free online maker for printable, numbered gift certificates with matching stubs. It works with no signup and runs entirely in the browser (nothing is uploaded). It prints 3 certificates per US Letter or A4 page, up to 500 per PDF, with a prefix, start number and zero padding; each stub repeats the certificate number and has blank Issued to, Date, Amount and Redeemed lines. It also saves a single certificate as a PNG for emailing, downloads an issue log CSV, and keeps a simple issue and redeem log in the browser's local storage. Every feature is free. There is no paid tier. Each sheet carries a small "Made with GiftStub" credit in the page margin, outside the certificates.

## Tool
- [Printable gift certificates with numbers](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/): design a certificate, set a number range and download a print-ready PDF with matching stubs.

## Templates
- [Gift certificate template with stub](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/gift-certificate-template-with-stub): what goes on the stub, numbering, layout and cutting.
- [Salon gift certificate template](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/salon-gift-certificate-template): dollar amount or named service, gratuity and booking notes.
- [Massage gift certificate template](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/massage-gift-certificate-template): session length, cancellation policy, packages.
- [Photography gift certificate template](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/photography-gift-certificate-template): session type, edited images, booking windows.
- [Christmas gift certificate template](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/christmas-gift-certificate-template): holiday wording, a seasonal prefix, last-minute PNG certificates.
- [Gift voucher template](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/gift-voucher-template): numbered gift vouchers with stubs on A4 for India and the UK, with ₹ (printed as Rs.) and £ amounts, terms and double-redemption checks.
- [Salon gift voucher format](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/salon-gift-voucher-format): voucher wording for salons, spas and beauty parlours, service or amount, terms and front-desk routine.
- [Diwali gift voucher](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/diwali-gift-voucher): festive numbered vouchers for shops, salons and businesses to give to customers or staff, with values, prefixes and printing on A4.

## Guides
- [How to track gift certificates](https://giftcert.roohsites.com/how-to-track-gift-certificates): number, log, redeem and reconcile gift certificates in a small business.

## Key facts
- Price: completely free. No paid tier.
- Privacy: certificates, logos and the log stay in the browser. No account.
- Output: PDF (pdf-lib), PNG image, CSV issue log.
- Presets: General, Salon, Massage & spa, Photography, Bakery, Auto detailing, Holiday, Voucher, Salon voucher, Diwali voucher.
- Voucher wording: the Voucher presets print "Gift Voucher" as the heading and open on A4. The rupee sign is printed as "Rs." (standard PDF fonts have no rupee symbol); the pound sign prints as £.
- Expiry date: optional and off by default. Gift certificate and voucher expiry and fee rules vary by country and US state; set clear terms and check local consumer rules.
